# Schelby D.C

> > Cologne-based boutique studio specializing in motion design, VFX, color grading, and postproduction services

Schelby D.C is a creative production studio located in Cologne, Germany, offering comprehensive visual services including CGI, animation, and video postproduction. The studio operates as a boutique agency serving clients with high-end motion design and visual effects needs.

## Key Topics

- Motion Design
- VFX & CGI
- Color Grading
- Postproduction
- Animation
- Video Production
- Boutique Studio
- Cologne
- Crew United
- Visual Effects
- Creative Services

## Studio Overview

- [Schelby D.C](https://www.schelby.tv): Cologne-based boutique studio for motion design, VFX, and postproduction
